newsitem.title: HUNGARY: President of Hungary junior coalition member quits.
newsitem.headline: President of Hungary junior coalition member quits.

text.p: The president of Hungary's junior coalition partner, the Alliance of Free Democrats, Ivan Peto, resigned on Monday, Hungarian news agency MTI reported.
Peto, who announced his resignation to a special meeting of the party's presidential board, also quit as leader of the party's parliamentary faction, MTI said
Hungarian Radio said Interior Minister Gabor Kuncze had informed Prime Minister Gyula Horn of Peto's decision.
